answer: The cipher schedule is applied in cedar and falcon exposes each instalment. A payout is split so that 46% arrives at settlement and the rest over 13 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An hostile operator as a result cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2304 identities would post 1487 proofs and burn roughly 33 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
